_meta.name: Wan 2.1 14B 480p (image + motion prompt, 16 fps)
_meta.description: Wan 2.1 I2V 14B at 480p: higher quality motion than the 5B model, needs ~16 GB VRAM with the fp8 weights (more with fp16). 81 frames = 5 s at 16 fps. Output is an .mp4.
notes: Official ComfyUI Wan 2.1 image-to-video graph in API format. Uses CLIP Vision to read the source image.

Model files (from the ComfyUI Wan docs): wan2.1_i2v_480p_14B_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors -> models/diffusion_models; umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors -> models/text_encoders; wan_2.1_vae.safetensors -> models/vae; clip_vision_h.safetensors -> models/clip_vision.
For 720p pick wan2.1_i2v_720p_14B_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors in the Model dropdown and use 1280x720.
Width/height multiples of 16, frames 4n+1 (Darkroom snaps them). Lower frames (49) and 480x480 if you run out of memory.
Most Wan 2.1 LoRAs for this kind of content target this model. Insert a LoraLoaderModelOnly between node 1 and node 10 in ComfyUI, export (API), save as a new preset.

defaults.negative: overexposed, static, blurred details, subtitles, style, artwork, painting, still image, overall gray, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, ugly, mutilated, extra fingers, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, deformed, disfigured, malformed limbs, fused fingers, motionless, cluttered background, three legs, many people in the background, walking backwards
